card.name: Counting and spacing words after numbers
card.fires_on: The word right after a number or count that fills in a quantity, such as "hours" in "12 hours apart", or "other", "each", "Prior" in lists of two items or steps.

modes.label: Hours apart
modes.description: The unit "hours" after a number in eye drop dosing intervals.

modes.label: Other or each in pairs
modes.description: Words like "other" or "each" that point to the second item of a counted pair.

modes.label: Step or period words
modes.description: A word naming a step, day or period in a dosing schedule or a rate.
modes.example: On the Day<< Prior>> to Colonoscopy
